# Evolvia Tech (Evolvia Infotech)

> AI-focused software development and IT engineering studio based in Maninagar, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We design and build custom web applications, mobile apps, applied AI systems, and scalable cloud infrastructure.

## Company Overview
- **Brand Name:** Evolvia Tech
- **Legal Entity:** Evolvia Infotech
- **Website:** https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/
- **Location:** Maninagar, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
- **Email:** vrvora11@gmail.com
- **Phone:** 8153875076
- **Business Hours:** 10 AM to 5 PM IST
- **Work Model:** Remote-first engineering team

## Core Services
- [Engineering Services Overview](https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/services): Full-lifecycle software, AI, and cloud capabilities.
- [Web Development](https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/services/web): Fast, search-friendly React and Next.js applications with Node.js/Go APIs.
- [Mobile App Development](https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/services/mobile): Cross-platform and native iOS/Android apps with React Native, Flutter, Swift, and Kotlin.
- [AI & Intelligent Systems](https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/services/ai): Custom LLM workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI integration.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/services/cloud): Scalable AWS/GCP architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform CI/CD.
- [UI/UX & Product Design](https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/services/design): Design systems, Figma prototyping, and accessible product interfaces.
- [Custom Software & SaaS](https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/services/software): Tailored multi-tenant SaaS platforms and enterprise software.
- [AI Chatbots & Agents](https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/services/ai-chatbots): Grounded conversational assistants for customer and internal support.
- [Document Q&A & RAG](https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/services/document-qa-rag): Auditable enterprise knowledge search over internal documents.
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://evolvia.vrvora11.workers.dev/services/workflow-automation): Automated document extraction, triage, and operational pipelines.

## Technology Stack
React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Go, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, GraphQL, React Native, Flutter, AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, OpenAI, LangChain.
